data.content:
Despite Manchester United sitting eight places above Tottenham in the table, they have actually conceded the same number of goals as the London outfit - eight. Moreover, United have yet to keep a clean sheet, while Spurs have kept two.
 Tottenham will be sweating on the fitness of central defenders Micky Van De Ven and Jan Paul Van Hecke for this match, as both picked up minor injuries on international duty, while United are potentially missing up to eight players. [...] Manchester United signed off for the international break with a draw against struggling Fulham. It was a poor performance that required a late equaliser from Matheus Cunha to salvage a point. Thus far, Michael Carrick's side have only collected one league win, over promoted Ipswich. [...] Manchester United's win over Tottenham at Old Trafford in February ended a bad run of form for the Red Devils in this fixture. Before that win, they'd failed to beat Spurs in their last seven meetings in all competitions.
